lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots are arranged in three to four distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, forming a semi-regular grid on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity (ridges) align with the primary columns of large circular spots, creating identifiable grid-like intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the upper edge and shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin surface displays a high-density distribution of smaller, non-uniformly spaced high-luminance spots, contrasting with the larger, structured spots on the lateral flank.
